text:
Alex: handing off primary -> secondary for the evening. I'm A-Primary until 03:00UTC, Sam you are on deck as secondary after 02:00UTC (I need to step out at 01:50). Current items: 1) Incident #INC-4512 (kv-cache thrash) is gated to a small subset of requests, mitigation in progress. 2) Increased 5xxs from embedder pool in us-west-2 (partial fallback to cpu-embed). 3) No active customer-facing outage but latency SLOs slipping on some routes. See quick pointers below.

Marta: copying runbook links and short action list below. If you take over, follow these in order: (1) confirm if pager is active -> `incident check INC-4512` (2) check kv cache hitrate dash -> Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/kvcache/hitrate (3) if kv node OOMs, route to warm standby: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback (4) confirm fallback policy for embedder: /runbooks/embedder-fallback.

Sam: noted. Quick note on paging: IncidentBot already paged primary at 00:14UTC, duplicate pager suppressed (reason: duplicate_policy). If you need to escalate to on-call lead, use `pager escalate --reason "customer latency >30s"` or ping @Liz directly. Ticket created: INC-4512. Customer impact tag: partial_degradation.

Liz: short remediation checklist I ran earlier and left in the incident:
- check KV cache heatmap (look for z-heap spikes)
- bump kv cache memlimit to 18G on affected nodes
- if mem bump fails, failover to standby group and warm prefixes
- force short-term routing to dedicated small-model variant (lower mem)

I left these commands in the thread for quick copy/paste:
```bash
# healthchecks
curl -sS https://healthapi.rw/v1/health && echo ok
# check embedder pods
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embedder
# restart a failing embedder pod (oncall only)
kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedder-usw2 -n inference
# increase redis mem limit (ops-only)
redis-cli -h kv-prod-1 config set maxmemory 19327352832
```

OncallBot: Reminder: Handoff checklist for night shift -> https://wiki.redwood/playbooks/night-handoff (auto-posted). Reaction: :bell:.

IncidentBot: ALERT summary for INC-4512: kv_cache CPU+OOM spikes on group kv-west-2, ~12 nodes affected, autoscaler did not trigger due to pinned reservations. Current mitigation: manual mem bump + route to standby. Severity: Sev3 -> monitored.

Alex: two small operational gotchas I want to call out before I go: (a) don't run global cache clears unless you confirm prefix invalidation with product (b) the canary rollout for the quantized embedder is still in progress; avoid manual promotion unless you coordinate with infra-releases.

Marta: quick fallback recipe (if latency continues > SLO and mem bump doesn't stick):
1) set route policy to `fallback-small-models` for the impacted tenant group (console -> routes -> edit) or via CLI: `rw routes set --group=us-west-2 --policy=fallback-small-models`
2) enable prefix KV warmup on standby: `rw kv warmup start --prefix=common_prefix --target=standby`
3) increase autoscale buffer to expedite new pods: `kubectl patch hpa embedder-usw2 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'`

Sam: if you take over and need a quick summary to paste into INC ticket: here you go (copyable):
"Primary: Alex (until 01:50UTC). Secondary: Sam (02:00UTC onward). Incident INC-4512: kv-cache thrash affecting latency on text-gen and embedding routes in us-west-2. Current mitigations: memlimit bump on kv nodes, routing to standby, restarting embedder pods in canary. Customer impact: partial_degradation; no full outage. Next steps: monitor kv hitrate and latency p99s for routes /gen/text and /embeds. Escalate to infra if OOMs persist after mem bump."

Liz: extra pro tip: if you see large KV TTL churn, run the following diagnostic to list hot keys (risk: heavy on redis, run during low load):
```bash
# find top keys by freq (redis 6+)
redis-cli --bigkeys | head -n 40
# or use module: redis-cli --stat 1 5
```

Marta: added quick links to the thread for runbooks and dashboards (copy these into the ticket):
- Runbook: kv cache fallback -> https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback
- Runbook: embedder fallback -> https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/embedder-fallback
- Playbook: night handoff -> https://wiki.redwood/playbooks/night-handoff
- Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/kvcache and https://grafana.redwood/d/embedder

Alex: ok I'm stepping out now, leaving notes in the ticket and the handoff doc. Sam please confirm when you pick up and post a brief status (OK to be a one-liner). If anything spikes, call me on mobile: +1-555-0182. :wave:

Sam: taking over now. Confirmed I can see the mem bumps applied, hitrate recovering slowly. I'll monitor for 30m then re-evaluate. If p95 > 2s after 30m I'll escalate. Acknowledged handoff.

OncallBot: Handoff acknowledged. Scheduled check-in reminder in 15m.

IncidentBot: INC-4512 update: kv hitrate improved from 42% -> 68% over last 12m, 5xxs steady but still elevated on two pods. Continuing monitoring.
